translations.text: Lord, to you I confess all my sins and my misdeeds, all that I ever spoke wrongly or did wrongly or thought wrongly,
in words and works and thoughts, whatever I remember or do not remember, whatever I did knowingly or unknowingly, under compulsion or without compulsion, sleeping or waking:
false oaths and lies, covetous desires and wicked deceits, fornications, in whatever way I committed them, and wicked sinful lusts in food and in drink and in wicked sleep;
that you, Lord, grant me salvation and grace, so that I may be without shame before your eyes, and that in this world I may have repentance and penance for my misdeeds, such as your mercies may be.
All-ruling Lord, God almighty, deign to help me and deign to grant me understanding and discernment, and a good will with right faith for your service.
Lord, you came into this world to save sinners; deign to keep me and save me.
Christ, Son of God, Lord, as you will and as is fitting for you, so do with me, your servant.
Lord, gracious God, deign to help me, your servant. You alone know, Lord, what my needs are.
Into your grace, Lord, I commend my heart, my thoughts, my will, my mind, my body, my words, my works.
Grant, Lord, your grace upon me, your sinful servant. Save me, Lord, from all evil.
